session_summary: Evaluated coin flow and marketplace pacing from a single completed Treasure Run session yielding 30 total coins (5 from steps, 25 completion reward). The player successfully purchased two mid-tier cosmetic items (Trail Cap for 45 coins and Moon Hood for 80 coins), leaving them with a balance of 21 coins and failing to afford the elite Waypoint Crown. Coin acquisition rates and marketplace item tiers create a compelling saving curve, though early income generation could benefit from structured payout milestones.

observations.evidence: Completing the Treasure Run provided 25 coins plus 5 found during steps (total 30). Combined with starting capital implied by purchases, two consecutive mid-tier purchases (Trail Cap 45c, Moon Hood 80c) nearly depleted reserves down to 21 coins, locking the player out of premium cosmetics like the Waypoint Crown.
observations.recommendation: Introduce a clear first-time completion bonus or daily bounty reward to bridge the currency gap for elite cosmetic items without breaking core route balance.

observations.evidence: Marketplace feedback correctly handled the insufficient funds state when attempting to purchase 'waypoint_crown' with only 21 coins remaining.
observations.recommendation: Keep the insufficient funds messaging informative, and consider adding a wishlist or saving goal tracker so players see how many more route runs are required for elite items.

feature_requests.title: Elite Cosmetic Saving Progress Bar
feature_requests.player_value: Gives players clear visibility into how close they are to purchasing high-tier items like the Waypoint Crown.
feature_requests.rationale: After buying two mid-tier cosmetics, the player was left with 21 coins and an explicit 'Not enough coins' block, which can feel discouraging without a clear target.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a UI progress tracker in the marketplace showing coin savings toward locked luxury items.

keep: Clear transaction feedback messages for successful and failed marketplace purchases
Meaningful pricing tiers that force players to choose between multiple mid-tier items or save up for elite cosmetics
focus: coin flow, marketplace value, reward pacing, meaningful spending decisions
